# prime-overlaybadge

prime-rs: OverlayBadge component (port of PrimeNG)

[Live demo](https://anton-avramchuk.github.io/prime-rs/overlaybadge) · [API docs](https://docs.rs/prime-overlaybadge)

OverlayBadge — port of `p-overlaybadge` from PrimeNG 21.1.10.

Root `div.p-overlaybadge` (instead of the host `<p-overlaybadge>`) with child content and a nested `Badge`.
`style_class` and `style` apply to the badge, as in PrimeNG; the corner position of the badge is set by the theme CSS.

```rust
use leptos::prelude::*;
use prime_overlaybadge::{OverlayBadge, BadgeSeverity};

let html = view! { <OverlayBadge value="2" severity=BadgeSeverity::Danger><span>"x"</span></OverlayBadge> }.to_html();
assert!(html.contains("p-overlaybadge") && html.contains("p-badge-danger"));
```

## Installation

```toml
[dependencies]
prime-overlaybadge = "0.1"
prime-theme = { version = "0.1", features = ["overlaybadge"] }
```

The component renders PrimeNG classes; its styles come from `prime-theme` (the Aura theme), one feature per component.
For server rendering enable the `ssr` feature in the server build and `hydrate` in the browser build.
Setting up an application (theme, SSR and hydration): https://anton-avramchuk.github.io/prime-rs/install
